subject: Free pilot: Los Angeles junk-removal leads from DumpRegistry
body:
Hi Example Junk Co,

DumpRegistry.org publishes city disposal guides. When residents in Los Angeles can’t self-haul, they request pickup on the page.

We’re opening a free pilot: your first 10 qualified Los Angeles leads at $0. Apply (no sales call):

https://www.dumpregistry.org/partners?city=los-angeles

If Los Angeles isn’t your market, reply with the cities you cover.

— DumpRegistry Partners
